import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Fix island label variants (case and space issues)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (stored as text in some rows)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Handle negative and out-of-range flipper_length_mm values
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average flipper length
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
